title: Reversing & Turning in the Road
whatItIs: Reversing and turning round are slow manoeuvres, but you can easily miss people around you. Choose a safe place and keep looking.
keyFacts: Choose a safe place: avoid turning round in a busy road. Find a quiet side road or go round the block.
Don't reverse from a side road into a main road.
At a driveway, reverse in and drive out forwards if you can.

keyFacts.text: You MUST NOT reverse further than you need to.

keyFacts: If you can't see properly behind you, get someone to guide you.

items.title: Pick the place
items.text: Quiet, with a good view, away from junctions and busy roads.

items.title: Look all round
items.text: Mirrors and blind spots. Look for children and cyclists.

items.title: Go slowly
items.text: Use clutch control so you can stop at once.

items.title: Keep looking
items.text: Look mainly out of the rear window, and all around.

items.title: Stop if needed
items.text: If someone approaches, stop and let them pass.

a.label: Driveway: reverse in
points: Best view of the road as you leave

b.label: Driveway: reverse out
points: Harder to see people and traffic

onTheTest.question: You need to turn your car round on a busy road. What should you do?
options: Find a quiet side road or drive round the block
Make a U-turn where the road is widest
Turn in the road using the kerbs
onTheTest.why: Avoid turning round in busy roads. Find a quiet side road or drive round a block of side streets.

traps: Mirrors alone aren't enough: look out of the rear window and all around.
Small children can be hidden right behind the car.
Never reverse from a side road into a main road.
